summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 2026 corporate presentation as Exhibit 99.1, signed by Chairman Julian Babarczy. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural term is disclosed in the excerpt; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. As a development-stage pharmaceutical registrant, the update appears informational, with no special-situation event. Watch for future 6-K disclosures on financing, clinical milestones, or strategic alternatives.
